newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate falls to 23.59 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate falls to 23.59 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 28-day interbank interest rate (TIIE) fell 33.50 basis points to 23.59 percent Wednesday from 23.925 percent Tuesday, Banco de Mexico said.
TIIP fell 188.78 basis points to 23.58 percent Wednesday from 25.4678 percent the week before.
The 91-day TIIE fell 75.00 basis points to 23.575 percent today from 24.3250 percent the week before.
TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is replacing TIIP, an average interbank rate.
